entities.summary: Kenneth Hans Kennholt is a Swedish former ice hockey defenceman. Kennholt mainly played for Djurgårdens IF and HV71 in the Swedish Elite League. He won four Swedish Championships during his career, three with Djurgården and one with HV71. Kennholt was drafted in 12th round, 252nd overall, by the Calgary Flames in the 1989 NHL entry draft.
